scripts.//prebuild: Fetches latest card data (non-fatal if API down) and busts Docker layer cache
scripts.prebuild: npx tsx scripts/fetchCards.ts || echo '⚠️  Card fetch failed, using existing data'; date > migrations/.buildstamp
scripts.migrate:status: npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts dev status && npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts prod status
scripts.test: npx tsx --test $(find src lib app scripts -name '*.test.ts' -not -path '*/qa/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -name 'botEval.test.ts' | sort)
scripts.test:all: npm run test; npm run qa; npm run test:e2e; npx tsx scripts/test-summary.ts
scripts.test:belts: npx tsx src/belts/BaseBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/CommonBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/FoilBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/HyperfoilBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/HyperspaceBelts.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/LeaderBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/RareLegendaryBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/ShowcaseLeaderBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/UncommonBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/CarboniteFoilRLBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/CarbonitePrestigeBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/CarboniteSlotBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/belts/beltConfig.test.ts
scripts.test:utils: npx tsx src/utils/boosterPack.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/carboniteBoosterPack.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/variantDowngrade.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/swudbExport.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/cardSort.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/aspectCombinations.test.ts
scripts.test:hooks: npx tsx src/hooks/useTooltip.test.ts && npx tsx src/hooks/useCardPreview.test.ts && npx tsx src/hooks/useChat.test.ts && npx tsx src/hooks/common/useIsMobile.test.ts && npx tsx src/hooks/common/useLocalStorage.test.ts && npx tsx src/hooks/useStickyTab.test.ts
scripts.test:auth: npx tsx lib/auth.test.ts && npx tsx src/utils/auth.test.ts && npx tsx app/api/beta/enroll/route.test.ts && npx tsx app/api/auth/callback/discord/route.test.ts && npx tsx app/api/auth/refresh/route.test.ts && npx tsx app/beta/page.test.ts && npx tsx scripts/makeAdmin.test.ts
scripts.test:data: npx tsx src/data/cards.test.ts; npx tsx src/data/cardCounts.test.ts
scripts.qa: npx tsx src/qa/packGeneration.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/beltSlotAspects.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/seamAwareBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/uc3Upgrade.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/lineStacking.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/sealedPodCollation.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/printerDistribution.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/foilDistribution.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/hyperspaceDistribution.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/carboniteDistribution.test.ts
scripts.qa:fast: npx tsx src/qa/packGeneration.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/beltSlotAspects.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/seamAwareBelt.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/uc3Upgrade.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/lineStacking.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/hyperspaceDistribution.test.ts && npx tsx src/qa/carboniteDistribution.test.ts
